title: cyclamen europaeum subsp. ponticum
intro: Cyclamen europaeum subsp. ponticum, commonly known as the Pontic cyclamen, is a species of flowering plant in the family Primulaceae, native to the Pontic Mountains in Turkey and the Caucasus. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cyclamen europaeum subsp. ponticum include its ability to act as a diuretic, help to reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
